clusters.objective: Ensure household members are woken on schedule with coordinated supporting actions (coffee ready at alarm; child's music and shutters at weekday 07:00).
clusters.meaningful_failure: inconvenience (missed or unprepared wake-up); disputed on r032
clusters.authorized_action_scope: explicit: start coffee machine; play wake music and raise shutters
clusters.rationale: Two independent owners in one study cluster converge on a scheduled wake-up outcome with accepted automation and explicit actions; below the 3-owner candidate threshold locally and no direct-path ratings (all compatible_only), so cross-packet confirmation is required.
clusters.boundary_notes: Not merged with veranda party scene (u24_r144): user-invoked one-shot scene, not a maintained routine. Not merged with safe_late_return (u24_r143): different lifecycle and failure meaning.
coding_disagreements: u06_r032 candidate_responsibility: luna=null vs kimi='have coffee ready at wake time'

clusters.objective: Protect dependent animals' wellbeing through automated environmental control: keep aquarium water at safe temperature and keep the home quiet for dogs when inhabitants are away.
clusters.meaningful_failure: harm or distress to animals (aquarium harm per kimi; dog distress as discomfort)
clusters.authorized_action_scope: explicit: activate heater and notify owner; silence intercom and telephone during absence
clusters.rationale: Two independent owners converge on animal welfare as the maintained outcome with explicit delegation; mechanisms and lifecycles differ but beneficiary (dependent animals) and failure (harm/distress) align. Below local thresholds; needs cross-packet owners.
clusters.boundary_notes: Merged only at outcome level (animal welfare); singleton split into 'aquarium temperature safety' and 'undisturbed pets during absence' is defensible if later evidence shows divergent lifecycles matter.

clusters.objective: When the occupant leaves, ensure the home is secured by arming the alarm once lights are off and windows closed, with confirmation.
clusters.authorized_action_scope: explicit: arm the alarm and notify the occupant
clusters.rationale: Single local owner, but facets are unusually complete: agreed beneficiary and failure meaning, recurring departures, accepted delegation, explicit authorized action. Needs additional owners cross-packet.
clusters.boundary_notes: Not merged with safe_late_return (u24_r143): departure arming vs arrival safety/notification are opposite transitions with different failure meanings. Not merged with storm shutdown (u06_r035).

clusters.objective: Enable a safe late-night return (dim pathway lighting) without disturbing other tenants, and notify a family member of the arrival.
clusters.meaningful_failure: harm during unsafe return (kimi) vs security_failure (luna)
clusters.authorized_action_scope: explicit: dim living-room lights and send arrival message to a predefined contact
clusters.rationale: Single local owner. Compound of lighting plus notification is preserved because the text ties both to one managed outcome (safe, low-disturbance return). Needs cross-packet owners.
clusters.boundary_notes: Not merged with secure_home_on_departure (u06_r037) despite shared door-trigger: arrival vs departure are distinct maintained outcomes.

clusters.objective: Prevent heating from running while windows are open, with occupant notification.
clusters.authorized_action_scope: explicit: turn off heating system and notify occupant
clusters.rationale: Single local owner with a clear maintained outcome (no simultaneous heating and ventilation) and explicit delegated action; failure meaning disputed between waste and discomfort. Needs cross-packet owners.
clusters.boundary_notes: Not merged with storm shutdown (u06_r035): waste avoidance vs event protection have different triggers and failures.

clusters.objective: Guarantee the weekly floor cleaning actually happens by triggering the robot vacuum if it was missed.
clusters.rationale: Single local owner, but the missed-run fallback shows a maintained recurring outcome rather than one-shot convenience. Needs cross-packet owners.
clusters.boundary_notes: Distinct from morning_wake_routine: different outcome (cleaning guarantee vs wake-up support).

clusters.objective: Reduce storm-related risk to the home by shutting down the TV and all lights when a storm occurs.
clusters.meaningful_failure: unknown in both codings; protection inferred
clusters.authorized_action_scope: explicit: turn off TV and all lights
clusters.rationale: Single local owner and purpose is unstated (both coders mark failure unknown); retained as a weak cluster rather than excluded because the coordinated shutdown implies asset protection, but exclusion as unsupported purpose is plausible.
clusters.boundary_notes: Exclusion as unsupported_purpose is a defensible alternative; flagged for adjudication.

clusters.objective: Alert the household before the refrigerator water dispenser runs out.
clusters.meaningful_failure: unknown in both codings; running out unawares inferred as inconvenience
clusters.rationale: Single local owner with notification-only action; the maintained outcome (supply awareness) is plausible but thin. Retained as weak cluster; mechanism-only exclusion is a defensible alternative.
clusters.boundary_notes: Notification-only scope; may be reclassified as mechanism-only on adjudication.

excluded_groups.rationale: Both are user-invoked, on-demand services (locate remote on spoken request; activate party scene on spoken command) with no maintained outcome, no recurrence guarantee, and no meaningful failure if never triggered. Both coders left candidate_responsibility null.

Daylight-tracking dimming states no purpose; beneficiary unknown; failure meaning disputed (luna=discomfort vs kimi=none); the independence unit itself is unresolved; both coders left candidate_responsibility null. Single owner in a separate study cluster with no local convergence.
